va-state.summary: VA Handbook Ch8 (Jul 2013): Tv first 1-in rainfall, 1-yr/24-hr channel protection; approved BMP groups rooftop-to-basin plus MTDs. Chapter-only excerpt.

nc-state.summary: NCDEQ C-0 chapter: general MDC for all SCMs; program-specific storm depth (e.g. 1 in HQW/ORW) and 10-year outlet protection.

nj-state.summary: NJ BMP Manual Ch5 (Jul 2023) + Ch9.7 (Jan 2026): WQDS 1.25-in/2-hr, quantity 2/10/100-yr via NRCS; small-scale bioretention GI. Multi-chapter excerpt.

ca-casqa-municipal.summary: CASQA 2003 municipal operations handbook with source-control fact sheets for fixed facilities and field programs plus treatment-control maintenance guidance.

boston-ma.summary: BWSC 2024 program report (needs_human_review): on-site infiltrate 1.0-in (<100k sf) / 1.25-in (≥100k sf) × impervious; TSS noted without % target.

miami-fl.summary: SFWMD ERP AH Vol II: 25-yr 3-day offsite discharge, 100-yr floors; WQ via AH Vol I plus District retention/exfiltration criteria.

detroit-mi.summary: Detroit DWSD 2025: retain/treat 90th-percentile 1.0-in WQv (80% TSS or ≤80 mg/L); 2-yr channel/infra protection; flood ≤0.15 cfs/ac 10-yr (<5ac) or 100-yr (≥5ac); Rational/Modified Rational/NRCS/SWMM; GSI BMPs.

phoenix-az.summary: Phoenix requires 100-year 2-hour on-site retention with First Flush (0.5 in) when waived; Rational and HEC-1 via Phoenix-DDMSW.

salt-lake-city-ut.summary: SLC MS4 SWMP: 0.2 cfs/ac 100-yr detention; 80th-percentile retention; Rational/<1ac and SCS CN methods via Design Manual.

boise-id.summary: Boise 2019 manual uses TR-55/Rational, 0.34-in water quality depth, 80% TSS removal, and infiltration/detention BMPs.

honolulu-hi.summary: Honolulu Aug 2017 drainage standards: 10/50/100-yr recurrence; Rational ≤100 ac, USGS Plate 6 >100 ac; WQv in separate Water Quality rules.

anchorage-ak.summary: MOA ASM Vol1 draft Mar 2015: WQ 0.52-in 90th-pctile GI; 1/10/100-yr peaks; Rational/NRCS/SWMM; bioretention–wetland BMPs.

indiana-manual.summary: Indiana 2007 manual treats 0.5-in from impervious, 80% TSS removal, pre-dev peak matching, and 10/100-year storms via Rational/TR-55/TR-20.

kentucky-bmp.summary: Kentucky Section 1 BMP manual covers KPDES construction BMP planning, erosion/sediment controls, LID post-construction principles, and Louisville 10-year/80% TSS reference.

kansas-city-marc-bmp.summary: MARC/APWA regional BMP manual using Level of Service and 1.37-inch WQv for Kansas City metro.

tx-edwards-rg348.summary: TCEQ RG-348 Edwards Aquifer BMP guidance requiring 80% TSS load reduction from new impervious cover.

south-salt-lake-ut.summary: South Salt Lake uses 0.6-in 80th-percentile WQv, 100-year 24-hr storms, Rational/TR-55, and LID BMP appendix.

hawaii-dot-pcbmp.summary: Hawaii DOT post-construction BMP manual sizing WQV from 1-inch 85th-percentile storm and WQFR via Rational Method at 0.4 in/hr.

albuquerque-nm-gsi.summary: Bernalillo County GSI/LID digest for desert communities citing Ordinance 2107-8 treatment volumes and standard construction details.

ca-caltrans-construction.summary: Caltrans March 2024 construction BMP manual with six temporary BMP categories, CGP/LTCGP minimums, RUSLE2 buffers, and approved post-construction TBMPs.

mn-state-2008.summary: Minnesota 2008 manual uses unified sizing (recharge, ~1.09-in WQv plus snowmelt, channel protection, 10- and 100-year floods) with TR-55/Rational and SCS Type II storms.

bismarck-nd.summary: Bismarck 2018 manual limits post-construction peaks to existing rates for 2/5/10/100-year storms, treats first 0.5 in runoff, and requires NRCS CN hydrology.

reno-nv.summary: Truckee Meadows 2015 manual sizes WQV from 0.60-in 90th-percentile storm and WQF from 2-year Rational Method across Reno, Sparks, and Washoe County.

oklahoma-odot-ch10.summary: ODOT Roadway Drainage Manual Ch. 10 (2014) uses 10-year pavement drainage, 50-year sag points, Rational Method peak flows, and HEC-22 storm sewer hydraulics.

ak-state.summary: Alaska Storm Water Guide (Dec 2011) uses 90% storm WQv (~0.5–1.25 in by region), unified 1/2/5/100-yr sizing, and municipal-accepted hydrology tools (Rational, TR-55, HEC-HMS).

wi-dnr-1001.summary: WDNR Tech Standard 1001 (10/07) sizes wet detention ponds with 1-yr WQ pool/active storage, 2-yr peak match, and 100-yr emergency spillway; not a full statewide manual.

mt-deq8.summary: Montana DEQ-8 (2024) requires 0.5-in initial capture on impervious area, 2-yr post≤pre peaks, and 2/10/100-yr analysis using Rational, Modified Rational, or TR-55.

billings-mt.summary: Montana 2017 MS4 post-construction guidance: 0.5-in RRV / 80% TSS, TR-55 RTF, and local 10/25/100-year flood control.

north-little-rock-ar.summary: NLR 2025 construction BMP manual; sediment traps sized for 0.5-in/24-hr runoff; no post-construction design storms.

ms-state-vol2.summary: MDEQ 2011 Vol. 2 uses Schueler Simple Method WQv (typically 1–1.5 in rainfall), SCS Curve Number peaks, and BMP treatment volumes by practice type.

new-orleans-jefferson-la.summary: 2010 Bayou Land BMP guidance for Orleans/Jefferson; cites NO 10-yr/24-hr and Jefferson 10-yr peak match; percent volume capture via SWMM.

baton-rouge-la.summary: EBR Parish 2007 Master Development Program stormwater BMPs; ten-year design storm baseline; detention/infiltration/filtration categories without quantified WQv.

wichita-ks-vol2.summary: Wichita/Sedgwick Vol.2 Ch.1 only: 1.2-in 85th-percentile WQv with 80% TSS; CPv 1-yr/2.8-in; flood peaks 2–100-yr. Needs review — intro chapter.

wy-wydot-field.summary: WYDOT construction stormwater field guide covering temporary erosion/sediment/housekeeping BMPs; no hydrologic design storms, WQv, or peak-flow methods in text.

de-wet-ponds-draft.summary: DNREC draft §13 Wet Ponds: 48-hr RPv extended detention for Wet ED ponds, Cv/Fv per DE regs, 100-year storage height limit; draft/public-notice status.

sd-dot-esc.summary: SDDOT Oct 2024 ESC course: temporary controls sized to 2-year/24-hr; construction BMP categories; no post-construction WQv or peak-flow methods.

ne-ndot-stf.summary: NDOT Ch3 (Apr 2018): WQV = first 0.5 in from new pavement, 80% TSS; WQV rate from 0.75-in/24-hr NRCS CN; STFs include filter strips through proprietary controls.

beatrice-ne.summary: Beatrice Aug 2020 DCM: 5/10 minor, 100 major, 2/10/100 detention; Region C WQCV 0.83-in 80th / 0.62-in 70th; Rational/NRCS with HY-8/HEC tools.

norfolk-va.summary: Norfolk Rev 3 (7/1/2024): Part II B 1/2/10-yr + 10-yr drains/100-yr regional; VRRM 0.41 lb/ac/yr P; Rational/SCS/NRCS; Clearinghouse BMPs.

chesapeake-va.summary: Chesapeake PFM Ch5 (12/16): 2–100-yr depths; 10/50-yr Rational by area; VRRM 10%/20% redev; acceptable HEC/SWMM/VRRM tools; Table 4.1 BMPs.

lacey-wa.summary: Lacey 2010 SDM Ch1-5: Ecology 2005-based; WWHM/Thurston 91st-pctile WQ; Table 5.4 2–100-yr; SBUH/TR-55/HSPF; LID/detention/infiltration/treatment BMPs.

nashville-tn-vol4.summary: Nashville SWMM Vol4 Sec1 intro only: 80% TSS / <1.1-in sizing context; temp/permanent BMP categories; needs_human_review — no return periods/methods in excerpt.

charlotte-nc.summary: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Apr 2026 public-comment conveyance manual: design storms 10/25/50/100-yr (Table 2-1); Rational + NRCS Type II 6-hr; HEC/HydroCAD/StormCAD verify; WQv not in this manual (post-construction ordinances).

savannah-ga-css.summary: GA Coastal Stormwater Supplement: 1.2-in RRv/first flush, 25-yr overbank and 100-yr extreme flood; SCS CN/TR-55 methods.

tucson-az.summary: Tucson Drainage Manual: Flood Peak Estimator/TSMS/HEC-1; 2–100 yr storms; threshold retention and stormwater harvesting.

tucson-az-detention.summary: Pima County detention/retention: 0.5-in first flush (85th %ile); 2/10/100-yr peak match; PC-Hydro and HEC-HMS.

tampa-fl.summary: SWFWMD ERP AH Vol II: 25-yr open / 100-yr closed basin; 1-in wet detention or 0.5-in retention/filtration/exfiltration; NRCS FL Modified + SCS/Rational.

gainesville-fl.summary: SRWMD ERP AH Vol II Jul 2024: 10-yr (ag) / 100-yr critical duration; WQ via Vol I + 72-hr recovery; Rational/NRCS/USGS; retention/detention/exfiltration BMPs.
